propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, respecting effective disables and project applicability instead of unconditional Round-A fan-in.
Project LLM criteria must select by effective globs and execute zero times when disabled/non-applicable, while project DET criteria execute outside LLM fan-in through detector selector.
Budget enforcement must shed over-budget units before calls; zero budget is schema-invalid and positive budgets are enforced with shed units recorded.
When one criterion fails, earlier successes must survive and independent criteria continue executing; blocking-capable missing coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists.
Code review response and status schemas remain backward-compatible; versioned safe discovery trace persists only in internal journal, never in public response.
